console.\"\"\"\n245\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n246\t\n247\tfrom fastapi import Request\n248\tfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\n249\tfrom jinja2 import pass_context\n250\t\n251\tfrom app import permissions, security, settings\n252\t\n253\ttemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))\n254\t# Templates use this only to hide controls; the server still checks every request.\n255\ttemplates.env.globals[\"can\"] = permissions.allowed\n256\t\n257\t\n258\t@pass_context\n259\tdef route(context, name: str, **params) -> str:\n260\t    \"\"\"The path of a named route, e.g. route('edit_post', post_id=3).\n261\t\n262\t    Templates use this instead of writing \"/admin/...\" by hand, so a link or\n263\t    form action follows its route if the route's path ever changes.\n264\t    \"\"\"\n265\t    return context[\"request\"].app.url_path_for(name, **params)\n266\t\n267\t\n268\ttemplates.env.globals[\"route\"] = route\n269\t\n270\t\n271\tdef render(request: Request, name: str, status_code: int = 200, **context):\n272\t    \"\"\"Render an admin template with the CSRF token every form needs.\"\"\"\n273\t    context.setdefault(\"title\", \"Admin\")\n274\t    context[\"csrf_token\"] = security.csrf_token(request)\n275\t    context[\"home_path\"] = request.app.url_path_for(\"dashboard\")\n276\t    return templates.TemplateResponse(request, name, context, status_code=status_code)\n277\t=== app/db.py\n278\t\"\"\"SQLite access. One short-lived connection per unit of work.\"\"\"\n279\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n280\t\n281\timport sqlite3\n282\tfrom pathlib import Path\n283\t\n284\tSCHEMA = \"\"\"\n285\tCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (\n286\t    id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n287\t    username      TEXT    NOT NULL UNIQUE COLLATE NOCASE,\n288\t    password_hash TEXT    NOT NULL,\n289\t    role          TEXT    NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('admin', 'editor')),\n290\t    display_name  TEXT    NOT NULL,\n291\t    active        INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (active IN (0, 1)),\n292\t    created_at    TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n293\t);\n294\t\n295\tCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS posts (\n296\t    id                 INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n297\t    title              TEXT    NOT NULL,\n298\t    slug               TEXT    NOT NULL UNIQUE,\n299\t    body               TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT '',\n300\t    status             TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft'\n301\t                               CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'published')),\n302\t    author_id          INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),\n303\t    created_at         TEXT    NOT NULL,\n304\t    updated_at         TEXT    NOT NULL,\n305\t    first_published_at TEXT\n306\t);\n307\t\"\"\"\n308\t\n309\t\n310\tdef connect(path: Path) -> sqlite3.Connection:\n311\t    \"\"\"Open the database, creating the file and tables on first use.\n312\t\n313\t    Use as `with closing(connect(path)) as conn, conn:` so the connection is\n314\t    closed and the transaction commits (or rolls back on error).\n315\t    \"\"\"\n316\t    conn = sqlite3.connect(path)\n317\t    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row\n318\t    conn.executescript(SCHEMA)\n319\t    return conn\n320\t=== app/main.py\n321\t\"\"\"The FastAPI application.\n322\t\n323\tThe admin console lives under /admin (signed-in only), with /login and /logout\n324\tbeside it; the public site preview answers at /.\n325\t\n326\tAdd your routes in their own modules (app/routes/posts.py and so on) and include\n327\tthem here. Keep this file small.\n328\t\"\"\"\n329\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n330\t\n331\tfrom pathlib import Path\n332\t\n333\tfrom fastapi import Depends, FastAPI, Request\n334\tfrom starlette.middleware.sessions import SessionMiddleware\n335\t\n336\tfrom app import security, settings\n337\tfrom app.permissions import PermissionRefused\n338\tfrom app.publish import WELCOME\n339\tfrom app.routes import admin, auth, posts\n340\tfrom app.web import render, templates\n341\t\n342\tSESSION_LIFETIME_SECONDS = 8 * 60 * 60\n343\t\n344\t\n345\tdef create_app(database: Path | None = None) -> FastAPI:\n346\t    # Every state-changing request is CSRF-checked, whatever route it reaches.\n347\t    app = FastAPI(title=\"IPHS 400 MP2 CMS\",\n348\t                  dependencies=[Depends(security.verify_csrf)])\n349\t    app.state.database = database or settings.DATABASE_PATH\n350\t\n351\t    app.include_router(auth.router)\n352\t    app.include_router(admin.router)\n353\t    app.include_router(posts.router)\n354\t\n355\t    @app.exception_handler(PermissionRefused)\n356\t    def refuse(request: Request, _: PermissionRefused):\n357\t        return render(request, \"admin/refused.html\", status_code=403,\n358\t                      title=\"No permission\", user=request.state.user)\n359\t\n360\t    @app.get(\"/\")\n361\t    def public_home(request: Request):\n362\t        return templates.TemplateResponse(\n363\t            request, \"public/home.html\",\n364\t            {\"title\": settings.SITE_TITLE, \"site_title\": settings.SITE_TITLE,\n365\t             \"root\": \"\", \"welcome\": WELCOME, \"posts\": []},\n366\t        )\n367\t\n368\t    # Middleware added last is outermost: the session must be loaded before the\n369\t    # guard runs, and saved after it.\n370\t    app.add_middleware(security.AdminGuard)\n371\t    app.add_middleware(\n372\t        SessionMiddleware, secret_key=settings.SECRET_KEY, session_cookie=\"cms_session\",\n373\t        max_age=SESSION_LIFETIME_SECONDS, same_site=\"lax\",\n374\t    )\n375\t    return app\n376\t\n377\t\n378\tapp = create_app()\n379\t=== app/routes/__init__.py\n380\t=== app/routes/admin.py\n381\t\"\"\"The admin console.  try:\n504\t        posts.update(_db(request), post_id, title=title, body=body)\n505\t    except posts.PostError as error:\n506\t        return _form(request, post=post, status_code=400, body_value=post[\"body\"])\n548\t    return RedirectResponse(_edit_url(request, post_id), status_code=303)\n549\t=== app/posts.py\n550\t\"\"\"Posts: the data rules (slugs, Author, First-published date).\n551\t\n552\tNothing here knows about HTTP. Slugs are made once from the title and only\n553\tchange through `change_slug`, which the routes reserve for the Admin.\n554\t\"\"\"\n555\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n556\t\n557\timport re\n558\timport sqlite3\n559\timport unicodedata\n560\tfrom contextlib import closing\n561\tfrom datetime import datetime, timezone\n562\tfrom pathlib import Path\n563\t\n564\tfrom app.db import connect\n565\t\n566\t\n567\tclass PostError(ValueError):\n568\t    \"\"\"A request about a Post that cannot be honoured (shown to the person).\"\"\"\n569\t\n570\t\n571\tclass TitleRequired(PostError):\n572\t    pass\n573\t\n574\t\n575\tclass SlugInvalid(PostError):\n576\t    pass\n577\t\n578\t\n579\tclass SlugTaken(PostError):\n580\t    pass\n581\t\n582\t\n583\tdef _now() -> str:\n584\t    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec=\"microseconds\")\n585\t\n586\t\n587\tdef slugify(text: str) -> str:\n588\t    ascii_text = unicodedata.normalize(\"NFKD\", text).encode(\"ascii\", \"ignore\").decode()\n589\t    return re.sub(r\"[^a-z0-9]+\", \"-\", ascii_text.lower()).strip(\"-\")\n590\t\n591\t\n592\tdef _unique_slug(conn: sqlite3.Connection, base: str) -> str:\n593\t    slug, number = base, 1\n594\t    while conn.execute(\"SELECT 1 FROM posts WHERE slug = ?\", (slug,)).fetchone():\n595\t        number += 1\n596\t        slug = f\"{base}-{number}\"\n597\t    return slug\n598\t\n599\t\n600\tdef _clean_title(title: str) -> str:\n601\t    title = title.strip()\n602\t    if not title:\n603\t        raise TitleRequired(\"A Post needs a title.\")\n604\t    return title\n605\t\n606\t\n607\t_WITH_AUTHOR = (\"SELECT posts.*, users.display_name AS author_name \"\n608\t                \"FROM posts JOIN users ON users.id = posts.author_id\")\n609\t\n610\t\n611\tdef create(path: Path, *, title: str, body: str, author_id: int) -> int:\n612\t    title = _clean_title(title)\n613\t    now = _now()\n614\t    with closing(connect(path)) as conn, conn:\n615\t        slug = _unique_slug(conn, slugify(title) or \"post\")\n616\t        cursor = conn.execute(\n617\t            \"INSERT INTO posts (title, slug, body, author_id, created_at, updated_at) \"\n618\t            \"VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n619\t            (title, slug, body, author_id, now, now),\n620\t        )\n621\t        return cursor.lastrowid\n622\t\n623\t\n624\tdef get(path: Path, post_id: int) -> sqlite3.Row | None:\n625\t    with closing(connect(path)) as conn:\n626\t        return conn.execute(f\"{_WITH_AUTHOR} WHERE posts.id = ?\", (post_id,)).fetchone()\n627\t\n628\t\n629\tdef list_all(path: Path) -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n630\t    with closing(connect(path)) as conn:\n631\t        return conn.execute(f\"{_WITH_AUTHOR} ORDER BY posts.updated_at DESC, posts.id DESC\"\n632\t                            ).fetchall()\n633\t\n634\t\n635\tdef update(path: Path, post_id: int, *, title: str, body: str) -> None:\n636\t    title = _clean_title(title)\n637\t    with closing(connect(path)) as conn, conn:\n638\t        conn.execute(\"UPDATE posts SET title = ?, body = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?\",\n639\t                     (title, body, _now(), post_id))\n640\t\n641\t\n642\tdef publish(path: Path, post_id: int) -> None:\n643\t    \"\"\"Mark Published. The First-published date is set once and never moved.\"\"\"\n644\t    with closing(connect(path)) as conn, conn:\n645\t        conn.execute(\n646\t            \"UPDATE posts SET status = 'published', \"\n647\t            \"first_published_at = COALESCE(first_published_at, ?) WHERE id = ?\",\n648\t            (_now(), post_id))\n649\t\n650\t\n651\tdef unpublish(path: Path, post_id: int) -> None:\n652\t    with closing(connect(path)) as conn, conn:\n653\t        conn.execute(\"UPDATE posts SET status = 'draft' WHERE id = ?\", (post_id,))\n654\t\n655\t\n656\tdef delete(path: Path, post_id: int) -> None:\n657\t    with closing(connect(path)) as conn, conn:\n658\t        conn.execute(\"DELETE FROM posts WHERE id = ?\", (post_id,))\n659\t\n660\t\n661\tdef change_slug(path: Path, post_id: int, slug: str) -> None:\n662\t    slug = slugify(slug)\n663\t    if not slug:\n664\t        raise SlugInvalid(\"A slug needs at least one letter or number.\")\n665\t    try:\n666\t        with closing(connect(path)) as conn, conn:\n667\t            conn.execute(\"UPDATE posts SET slug = ? WHERE id = ?\", (slug, post_id))\n668\t    except sqlite3.IntegrityError:\n669\t        raise SlugTaken(f\"Another Post already uses '{slug}'.\") from None\n670\t=== app/publish.py\n671\t\"\"\"Render the public site into site/ as plain HTML.\n672\t\n673\tTwo rules the rubric checks:\n674\t\n675\t  1. Only PUBLISHED content is written here. A draft that reaches site/ is a bug.\n676\t  2. Every href and src is RELATIVE (\"style.css\", \"posts/x.html\"), never\n677\t     root-absolute (\"/style.css\"), because Pages serves this from a subfolder.\n678\t     Pages one folder down (posts/) reach the site root with a `root` of \"../\".\n679\t\"\"\"\n680\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n681\t\n682\timport shutil\n683\timport sqlite3\n684\tfrom contextlib import closing\n685\tfrom datetime import datetime\n686\tfrom pathlib import Path\n687\t\n688\tfrom jinja2 import Environment, FileSystemLoader, select_autoescape\n689\t\n690\tfrom app import settings\n691\tfrom app.db import connect\n692\tfrom app.rendering import render_body\n693\t\n694\t# The wording comes from notes/client-brief.md. Make no other claim about ASA.\n695\tWELCOME = (\n696\t    \"ASA is a Kenyon student group primarily for African students and students \"\n697\t    \"with African backgrounds, while welcoming anyone interested in African \"\n698\t    \"cultures and community.\"\n699\t)\n700\tHOME_ANNOUNCEMENTS = 5\n701\t\n702\tCSS = \"\"\"/* Minimal starter styles — make them yours. */\n703\t:root { color-scheme: light dark; }\n704\tbody { font: 16px/1.6 system-ui, sans-serif; margin: 0 auto; max-width: 42rem; padding: 1rem; }\n705\theader { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.5rem 1.5rem; align-items: baseline; }\n706\theader a { font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; }\n707\ta:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid currentColor; outline-offset: 2px; }\n708\tmain { margin-block: 2rem; }\n709\timg { max-width: 100%; height: auto; }\n710\t.card { border: 1px solid; border-radius: 0.5rem; padding: 0.75rem 1rem; margin-block: 1rem; }\n711\t.card-title { margin: 0; font-size: 1.2rem; }\n712\t.meta { margin: 0.25rem 0 0; font-size: 0.9rem; opacity: 0.8; }\n713\t\"\"\"\n714\t\n715\t\n716\tdef environment() -> Environment:\n717\t    return Environment(\n718\t        loader=FileSystemLoader(str(settings.TEMPLATES)),\n719\t        autoescape=select_autoescape([\"html\"]),\n720\t    )\n721\t\n722\t\n723\tdef _day(timestamp: str) -> tuple[str, str]:\n724\t    \"\"\"A stored UTC timestamp as (\"2026-09-28\", \"28 September 2026\").\"\"\"\n725\t    moment = datetime.fromisoformat(timestamp)\n726\t    return moment.date().isoformat(), f\"{moment.day} {moment:%B %Y}\"\n727\t\n728\t\n729\tdef _published_posts(database: Path) -> list[dict]:\n730\t    \"\"\"Published Posts only, newest First-published date first.\n731\t\n732\t    Ordered by First-published date, not by edit time, so a correction never\n733\t    moves a Post. The byline is the Author's Display name; the Username is not\n734\t    even selected.\n735\t    \"\"\"\n736\t    with closing(connect(database)) as conn:\n737\t        rows = conn.execute(\n738\t            \"SELECT posts.title, posts.slug, posts.body, posts.updated_at, \"\n739\t            \"posts.first_published_at, users.display_name AS author_name \"\n740\t            \"FROM posts JOIN users ON users.id = posts.author_id \"\n741\t            \"WHERE posts.status = 'published' \"\n742\t            \"ORDER BY posts.first_published_at DESC, posts.id DESC\"\n743\t        ).fetchall()\n744\t    return [_post_for_template(row) for row in rows]\n745\t\n746\t\n747\tdef _post_for_template(row: sqlite3.Row) -> dict:\n748\t    posted_iso, posted_label = _day(row[\"first_published_at\"])\n749\t    post = {\n750\t        \"title\": row[\"title\"], \"slug\": row[\"slug\"], \"author_name\": row[\"author_name\"],\n751\t        \"body_html\": render_body(row[\"body\"]),\n752\t        \"posted_iso\": posted_iso, \"posted_label\": posted_label,\n753\t        \"updated_iso\": None, \"updated_label\": None,\n754\t    }\n755\t    if row[\"updated_at\"] > row[\"first_published_at\"]:\n756\t        post[\"updated_iso\"], post[\"updated_label\"] = _day(row[\"updated_at\"])\n757\t    return post\n758\t\n759\t\n760\tdef render_site(out: Path | None = None, database: Path | None = None) -> Path:\n761\t    out = out or settings.SITE\n762\t    database = database or settings.DATABASE_PATH\n763\t    if out.exists():\n764\t        shutil.rmtree(out)\n765\t    (out / app/accounts.py\n\"\"\"Accounts: creating them, hashing passwords, checking sign-in.\n\nA password is never stored, returned or logged in plain form; only the argon2\nhash is kept. The username is private (sign-in only); the Display name is the\npublic byline. Accounts are deactivated, never deleted.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\nfrom contextlib import closing\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom argon2 import PasswordHasher\nfrom argon2.exceptions import InvalidHashError, VerificationError\n\nfrom app.db import connect\n\nROLES = (\"admin\", \"editor\")\nMIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH = 8\n\n_hasher = PasswordHasher()\n# Checked when the username is unknown, so a miss takes as long as a wrong\n# password and timing does not reveal which usernames exist.\n_DUMMY_HASH = _hasher.hash(\"not-a-real-password\")\n\n\nclass AccountError(ValueError):\n    \"\"\"A request to create an account that cannot be honoured.\"\"\"\n\n\nclass UsernameTaken(AccountError):\n    pass\n\n\ndef hash_password(password: str) -> str:\n    return _hasher.hash(password)\n\n\ndef _password_matches(stored_hash: str, password: str) -> bool:\n    try:\n        return _hasher.verify(stored_hash, password)\n    except (VerificationError, InvalidHashError):\n        return False\n\n\ndef create_account(path: Path, *, username: str, password: str, role: str,\n                   display_name: str) -> int:\n    username, display_name = username.strip(), display_name.strip()\n    if not username or not display_name:\n        raise AccountError(\"A username and a Display name are required.\")\n    if role not in ROLES:\n        raise AccountError(f\"Role must be one of: {', '.join(ROLES)}.\")\n    if len(password) < MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH:\n        raise AccountError(\n            f\"The password must be at least {MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH} characters.\")\n    try:\n        with closing(connect(path)) as conn, conn:\n            cursor = conn.execute(\n                \"INSERT INTO users (username, password_hash, role, display_name) \"\n                \"VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n                (username, hash_password(password), role, display_name),\n            )\n            return cursor.lastrowid\n    except sqlite3.IntegrityError:\n        raise UsernameTaken(f\"An account named '{username}' already exists.\") from None\n\n\ndef authenticate(path: Path, username: str, password: str) -> sqlite3.Row | None:\n    \"\"\"Return the account for a correct username and password, else None.\n\n    An unknown username, a wrong password and a Deactivated account all return\n    None, so the caller can give one generic message for all three.\n    \"\"\"\n    with closing(connect(path)) as conn:\n        user = conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT * FROM users WHERE username = ?\", (username.strip(),)\n        ).fetchone()\n    matches = _password_matches(user[\"password_hash\"] if user else _DUMMY_HASH,\n                                password)\n    if user is None or not matches or not user[\"active\"]:\n        return None\n    return user\n\n\ndef get_user(path: Path, user_id: int) -> sqlite3.Row | None:\n    with closing(connect(path)) as conn:\n        return conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ?\", (user_id,)).fetchone()\n\n\ndef set_active(path: Path, username: str, active: bool) -> None:\n    with closing(connect(path)) as conn, conn:\n        conn.execute(\"UPDATE users SET active = ? WHERE username = ?\",\n                     (int(active), username))\n\n\ndef seed_demo_accounts(path: Path, *, admin_password: str,\n                       editor_password: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Create the demo Admin and Editor if they do not exist yet.\"\"\"\n    demo = [\n        (\"admin\", admin_password, \"admin\", \"ASA Leadership\"),\n        (\"editor\", editor_password, \"editor\", \"ASA Events Team\"),\n    ]\n    for username, password, role, display_name in demo:\n        try:\n            create_account(path, username=username, password=password, role=role,\n                           display_name=display_name)\n        except UsernameTaken:\n            pass\n=== app/permissions.py\n\"\"\"The one place that says who may do what.\n\nEvery state-changing or Admin-only route asks `require(action)`. Templates ask\n`can(role, action)` only to hide controls; hiding is never the protection.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import Request\n\nADMIN = \"admin\"\nEDITOR = \"editor\"\nEVERYONE = frozenset({ADMIN, EDITOR})\nADMIN_ONLY = frozenset({ADMIN})\n\nRULES: dict[str, frozenset[str]] = {\n    \"post.list\": EVERYONE,\n    \"post.create\": EVERYONE,\n    \"post.edit\": EVERYONE,\n    \"post.publish\": EVERYONE,\n    \"post.unpublish\": EVERYONE,\n    \"post.delete\": ADMIN_ONLY,\n    \"post.change_slug\": ADMIN_ONLY,\n}\n\n\nclass PermissionRefused(Exception):\n    \"\"\"The signed-in account's role may not do this action.\"\"\"\n\n\ndef allowed(role: str, action: str) -> bool:\n    # An action missing from the table is refused, never allowed by accident.\n    return role in RULES.get(action, frozenset())\n\n\ndef require(action: str):\n    \"\"\"A route dependency: refuse the request unless the role may `action`.\n\n    Runs before the route looks anything up, so an Editor gets the same\n    refusal whether or not the thing they asked about exists.\n    \"\"\"\n    if action not in RULES:\n        raise KeyError(f\"unknown action: {action}\")\n\n    def check(request: Request) -> None:\n        if not allowed(request.state.user[\"role\"], action):\n            raise PermissionRefused(action)\n\n    return check\n=== app/security.py\n\"\"\"Who is signed in, and CSRF protection.\n\nThe session is a signed cookie (Starlette SessionMiddleware). It holds only the\naccount id and a CSRF token. The account is looked up on every request, so a\nDeactivated account stops working immediately.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport secrets\nimport sqlite3\n\nfrom fastapi import HTTPException, Request\nfrom starlette.responses import RedirectResponse\nfrom starlette.types import ASGIApp, Receive, Scope, Send\n\nfrom app import accounts\n\nSAFE_METHODS = {\"GET\", \"HEAD\", \"OPTIONS\"}\n\n\ndef current_user(request: Request) -> sqlite3.Row | None:\n    \"\"\"The signed-in, active account for this request, or None.\"\"\"\n    user_id = request.session.get(\"user_id\")\n    if user_id is None:\n        return None\n    user = accounts.get_user(request.app.state.database, user_id)\n    if user is None or not user[\"active\"]:\n        request.session.clear()\n        return None\n    return user\n\n\ndef sign_in(request: Request, user: sqlite3.Row) -> None:\n    # A fresh session (and CSRF token) on sign-in, so nothing from before it lives on.\n    request.session.clear()\n    request.session[\"user_id\"] = user[\"id\"]\n\n\ndef sign_out(request: Request) -> None:\n    request.session.clear()\n\n\ndef csrf_token(request: Request) -> str:\n    token = request.session.get(\"csrf\")\n    if not token:\n        token = request.session[\"csrf\"] = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)\n    return token\n\n\nasync def verify_csrf(request: Request) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Reject any state-changing request that lacks this session's token.\n\n    Registered on the whole app, so a new route cannot forget it.\n    \"\"\"\n    if request.method in SAFE_METHODS:\n        return\n    expected = request.session.get(\"csrf\")\n    form = await request.form()\n    supplied = form.get(\"csrf_token\") or \"\"\n    if not expected or not secrets.compare_digest(str(supplied), expected):\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail=\"Invalid or missing CSRF token.\")\n\n\nclass AdminGuard:\n    \"\"\"Send anyone who is not signed in away from every /admin address.\n\n    A middleware rather than a per-route check, so it also covers addresses\n    that do not exist (they must not answer differently to a signed-out visitor).\n    \"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, app: ASGIApp) -> None:\n        self.app = app\n\n    async def __call__(self, scope: Scope, receive: Receive, send: Send) -> None:\n        if scope[\"type\"] == \"http\" and (\n                scope[\"path\"] == \"/admin\" or scope[\"path\"].startswith(\"/admin/\")):\n            request = Request(scope, receive)\n            user = current_user(request)\n            if user is None:\n                await RedirectResponse(\"/login\", status_code=303)(scope, receive, send)\n                return\n            scope.setdefault(\"state\", {})[\"user\"] = user\n        await self.app(scope, receive, send)\n=== app/web.py\n\"\"\"Template rendering for the admin console.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import Request\nfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\nfrom jinja2 import pass_context\n\nfrom app import permissions, security, settings\n\ntemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))\n# Templates use this only to hide controls; the server still checks every request.\ntemplates.env.globals[\"can\"] = permissions.allowed\n\n\n@pass_context\ndef route(context, name: str, **params) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The path of a named route, e.g. route('edit_post', post_id=3).\n\n    Templates use this instead of writing \"/admin/...\" by hand, so a link or\n    form action follows its route if the route's path ever changes.\n    \"\"\"\n    return context[\"request\"].app.url_path_for(name, **params)\n\n\ntemplates.env.globals[\"route\"] = route\n\n\ndef render(request: Request, name: str, status_code: int = 200, **context):\n    \"\"\"Render an admin template with the CSRF token every form needs.\"\"\"\n    context.setdefault(\"title\", \"Admin\")\n    context[\"csrf_token\"] = security.csrf_token(request)\n    context[\"home_path\"] = request.app.url_path_for(\"dashboard\")\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(request, name, context, status_code=status_code)\n=== app/db.py\n\"\"\"SQLite access. One short-lived connection per unit of work.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nSCHEMA = \"\"\"\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (\n    id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    username      TEXT    NOT NULL UNIQUE COLLATE NOCASE,\n    password_hash TEXT    NOT NULL,\n    role          TEXT    NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('admin', 'editor')),\n    display_name  TEXT    NOT NULL,\n    active        INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (active IN (0, 1)),\n    created_at    TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS posts (\n    id                 INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    title              TEXT    NOT NULL,\n    slug               TEXT    NOT NULL UNIQUE,\n    body               TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT '',\n    status             TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft'\n                               CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'published')),\n    author_id          INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),\n    created_at         TEXT    NOT NULL,\n    updated_at         TEXT    NOT NULL,\n    first_published_at TEXT\n);\n\"\"\"\n\n\ndef connect(path: Path) -> sqlite3.Connection:\n    \"\"\"Open the database, creating the file and tables on first use.\n\n    Use as `with closing(connect(path)) as conn, conn:` so the connection is\n    closed and the transaction commits (or rolls back on error).\n    \"\"\"\n    conn = sqlite3.connect(path)\n    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row\n    conn.executescript(SCHEMA)\n    return conn\n=== app/main.py\n\"\"\"The FastAPI application.\n\nThe admin console lives under /admin (signed-in only), with /login and /logout\nbeside it; the public site preview answers at /.\n\nAdd your routes in their own modules (app/routes/posts.py and so on) and include\nthem here. Keep this file small.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom fastapi import Depends, FastAPI, Request\nfrom starlette.middleware.sessions import SessionMiddleware\n\nfrom app import security, settings\nfrom app.permissions import PermissionRefused\nfrom app.publish import WELCOME\nfrom app.routes import admin, auth, posts\nfrom app.web import render, templates\n\nSESSION_LIFETIME_SECONDS = 8 * 60 * 60\n\n\ndef create_app(database: Path | None = None) -> FastAPI:\n    # Every state-changing request is CSRF-checked, whatever route it reaches.\n    app = FastAPI(title=\"IPHS 400 MP2 CMS\",\n                  dependencies=[Depends(security.verify_csrf)])\n    app.state.database = database or settings.DATABASE_PATH\n\n    app.include_router(auth.router)\n    app.include_router(admin.router)\n    app.include_router(posts.router)\n\n    @app.exception_handler(PermissionRefused)\n    def refuse(request: Request, _: PermissionRefused):\n        return render(request, \"admin/refused.html\", status_code=403,\n                      title=\"No permission\", user=request.state.user)\n\n    @app.get(\"/\")\n    def public_home(request: Request):\n        return templates.TemplateResponse(\n            request, \"public/home.html\",\n            {\"title\": settings.SITE_TITLE, \"site_title\": settings.SITE_TITLE,\n             \"root\": \"\", \"welcome\": WELCOME, \"posts\": []},\n        )\n\n    # Middleware added last is outermost: the session must be loaded before the\n    # guard runs, and saved after it.\n    app.add_middleware(security.AdminGuard)\n    app.add_middleware(\n        SessionMiddleware, secret_key=settings.SECRET_KEY, session_cookie=\"cms_session\",\n        max_age=SESSION_LIFETIME_SECONDS, same_site=\"lax\",\n    )\n    return app\n\n\napp = create_app()\n=== app/routes/__init__.py\n=== app/routes/admin.py\n\"\"\"The admin console. Everything under /admin is guarded by security.AdminGuard.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Request\n\nfrom app.web import render\n\nrouter = APIRouter(prefix=\"/admin\")\n\n\n@router.get(\"\")\ndef dashboard(request: Request):\n    return render(request, \"admin/dashboard.html\", title=\"Dashboard\",\n                  user=request.state.user)\n=== app/routes/auth.py\n\"\"\"Sign in and sign out.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Form, Request\nfrom fastapi.responses import RedirectResponse\n\nfrom app import accounts, security\nfrom app.web import render\n\nrouter = APIRouter()\n\n# One message for every failure, so it never reveals which part was wrong.\nGENERIC_FAILURE = \"Incorrect username or password.\"\n\n\n@router.get(\"/login\")\ndef login_form(request: Request):\n    if security.current_user(request):\n        return RedirectResponse(request.app.url_path_for(\"dashboard\"), status_code=303)\n    return render(request, \"admin/login.html\", title=\"Sign in\")\n\n\n@router.post(\"/login\")\ndef login(request: Request, username: str = Form(\"\"), password: str = Form(\"\")):\n    user = accounts.authenticate(request.app.state.database, username, password)\n    if user is None:\n        return render(request, \"admin/login.html\", status_code=401,\n                      title=\"Sign in\", error=GENERIC_FAILURE)\n    security.sign_in(request, user)\n    return RedirectResponse(request.app.url_path_for(\"dashboard\"), status_code=303)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/logout\")\ndef logout(request: Request):\n    security.sign_out(request)\n    return RedirectResponse(request.app.url_path_for(\"login_form\"), status_code=303)\n=== app/routes/posts.py\n\"\"\"Post screens: list, write, edit, publish, delete, and the Admin-only slug.\n\nEach route names its action in `Depends(require(...))`; the rule table in\napp/permissions.py decides who may. Permission is checked before the Post is\nlooked up.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Form, HTTPException, Request\nfrom fastapi.responses import RedirectResponse\n\nfrom app import posts\nfrom app.permissions import require\nfrom app.web import render\n\nrouter = APIRouter(prefix=\"/admin/posts\")\n\n\ndef _db(request: Request):\n    return request.app.state.database\n\n\ndef _edit_url(request: Request, post_id: int) -> str:\n    return request.app.url_path_for(\"edit_post\", post_id=post_id)\n\n\ndef _found(request: Request, post_id: int):\n    post = posts.get(_db(request), post_id)\n    if post is None:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=\"No such Post.\")\n    return post\n\n\ndef _form(request: Request, *, post=None, status_code=200, **context):\n    return render(request, \"admin/post_form.html\", status_code=status_code,\n                  title=\"Edit Post\" if post else \"New Post\", user=request.state.user,\n                  post=post, **context)\n\n\n@router.get(\"\", dependencies=[Depends(require(\"post.list\"))])\ndef post_list(request: Request):\n    return render(request, \"admin/post_list.html\", title=\"Posts\",\n                  user=request.state.user, posts=posts.list_all(_db(request)))\n\n\n@router.get(\"/new\", dependencies=[Depends(require(\"post.create\"))])\ndef new_post(request: Request):\n    return _form(request, title_value=\"\", body_value=\"\")\n\n\n@router.post(\"\", dependencies=[Depends(require(\"post.create\"))])\ndef create_post(request: Request, title: str = Form(\"\"), body: str = Form(\"\")):\n    try:\n        post_id = posts.create(_db(request), title=title, body=body,\n                               author_id=request.state.user[\"id\"])\n    except posts.PostError as error:\n        return _form(request, status_code=400, error=str(error),\n                     title_value=title, body_value=body)\n    return RedirectResponse(_edit_url(request, post_id), status_code=303)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/{post_id}/edit\", dependencies=[Depends(require(\"post.edit\"))])\ndef edit_post(request: Request, post_id: int):\n    post = _found(request, post_id)\n    return _form(request, post=post, title_value=post[\"title\"], body_value=post[\"body\"])\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{post_id}\", dependencies=[Depends(require(\"post.edit\"))])\ndef save_post(request: Request, post_id: int, title: str = Form(\"\"), body: str = Form(\"\")):\n    post = _found(request, post_id)\n    try:\n        posts.update(_db(request), post_id, title=title, body=body)\n    except posts.PostError as error:\n        return _form(request, post=post, status_code=400, error=str(error),\n                     title_value=title, body_value=body)\n    return RedirectResponse(_edit_url(request, post_id), status_code=303)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{post_id}/publish\", dependencies=[Depends(require(\"post.publish\"))])\ndef publish_post(request: Request, post_id: int):\n    _found(request, post_id)\n    posts.publish(_db(request), post_id)\n    return RedirectResponse(_edit_url(request, post_id), status_code=303)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{post_id}/unpublish\", dependencies=[Depends(require(\"post.unpublish\"))])\ndef unpublish_post(request: Request, post_id: int):\n    _found(request, post_id)\n    posts.unpublish(_db(request), post_id)\n    return RedirectResponse(_edit_url(request, post_id), status_code=303)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{post_id}/delete\", dependencies=[Depends(require(\"post.delete\"))])\ndef delete_post(request: Request, post_id: int):\n    _found(request, post_id)\n    posts.delete(_db(request), post_id)\n    return RedirectResponse(request.app.url_path_for(\"post_list\"), status_code=303)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/{post_id}/slug\", dependencies=[Depends(require(\"post.change_slug\"))])\ndef slug_form(request: Request, post_id: int):\n    # The slug form lives on the edit page, beside its warning.\n    _found(request, post_id)\n    return RedirectResponse(_edit_url(request, post_id) + \"#slug\", status_code=303)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{post_id}/slug\", dependencies=[Depends(require(\"post.change_slug\"))])\ndef change_slug(request: Request, post_id: int, slug: str = Form(\"\")):\n    post = _found(request, post_id)\n    try:\n        posts.change_slug(_db(request), post_id, slug)\n    except posts.PostError as error:\n        code = 409 if isinstance(error, posts.SlugTaken) else 400\n        return _form(request, post=post, status_code=code, slug_error=str(error),\n                     title_value=post[\"title\"], body_value=post[\"body\"])\n    return RedirectResponse(_edit_url(request, post_id), status_code=303)\n=== app/posts.py\n\"\"\"Posts: the data rules (slugs, Author, First-published date).\n\nNothing here knows about HTTP. Slugs are made once from the title and only\nchange through `change_slug`, which the routes reserve for the Admin.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nimport sqlite3\nimport unicodedata\nfrom contextlib import closing\nfrom datetime import datetime, timezone\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom app.db import connect\n\n\nclass PostError(ValueError):\n    \"\"\"A request about a Post that cannot be honoured (shown to the person).\"\"\"\n\n\nclass TitleRequired(PostError):\n    pass\n\n\nclass SlugInvalid(PostError):\n    pass\n\n\nclass SlugTaken(PostError):\n    pass\n\n\ndef _now() -> str:\n    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec=\"microseconds\")\n\n\ndef slugify(text: str) -> str:\n    ascii_text = unicodedata.normalize(\"NFKD\", text).encode(\"ascii\", \"ignore\").decode()\n    return re.sub(r\"[^a-z0-9]+\", \"-\", ascii_text.lower()).strip(\"-\")\n\n\ndef _unique_slug(conn: sqlite3.Connection, base: str) -> str:\n    slug, number = base, 1\n    while conn.execute(\"SELECT 1 FROM posts WHERE slug = ?\", (slug,)).fetchone():\n        number += 1\n        slug = f\"{base}-{number}\"\n    return slug\n\n\ndef _clean_title(title: str) -> str:\n    title = title.strip()\n    if not title:\n        raise TitleRequired(\"A Post needs a title.\")\n    return title\n\n\n_WITH_AUTHOR = (\"SELECT posts.*, users.display_name AS author_name \"\n                \"FROM posts JOIN users ON users.id = posts.author_id\")\n\n\ndef create(path: Path, *, title: str, body: str, author_id: int) -> int:\n    title = _clean_title(title)\n    now = _now()\n    with closing(connect(path)) as conn, conn:\n        slug = _unique_slug(conn, slugify(title) or \"post\")\n        cursor = conn.execute(\n            \"INSERT INTO posts (title, slug, body, author_id, created_at, updated_at) \"\n            \"VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n            (title, slug, body, author_id, now, now),\n        )\n        return cursor.lastrowid\n\n\ndef get(path: Path, post_id: int) -> sqlite3.Row | None:\n    with closing(connect(path)) as conn:\n        return conn.execute(f\"{_WITH_AUTHOR} WHERE posts.id = ?\", (post_id,)).fetchone()\n\n\ndef list_all(path: Path) -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n    with closing(connect(path)) as conn:\n        return conn.execute(f\"{_WITH_AUTHOR} ORDER BY posts.updated_at DESC, posts.id DESC\"\n                            ).fetchall()\n\n\ndef update(path: Path, post_id: int, *, title: str, body: str) -> None:\n    title = _clean_title(title)\n    with closing(connect(path)) as conn, conn:\n        conn.execute(\"UPDATE posts SET title = ?, body = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?\",\n                     (title, body, _now(), post_id))\n\n\ndef publish(path: Path, post_id: int) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Mark Published. The First-published date is set once and never moved.\"\"\"\n    with closing(connect(path)) as conn, conn:\n        conn.execute(\n            \"UPDATE posts SET status = 'published', \"\n            \"first_published_at = COALESCE(first_published_at, ?) WHERE id = ?\",\n            (_now(), post_id))\n\n\ndef unpublish(path: Path, post_id: int) -> None:\n    with closing(connect(path)) as conn, conn:\n        conn.execute(\"UPDATE posts SET status = 'draft' WHERE id = ?\", (post_id,))\n\n\ndef delete(path: Path, post_id: int) -> None:\n    with closing(connect(path)) as conn, conn:\n        conn.execute(\"DELETE FROM posts WHERE id = ?\", (post_id,))\n\n\ndef change_slug(path: Path, post_id: int, slug: str) -> None:\n    slug = slugify(slug)\n    if not slug:\n        raise SlugInvalid(\"A slug needs at least one letter or number.\")\n    try:\n        with closing(connect(path)) as conn, conn:\n            conn.execute(\"UPDATE posts SET slug = ? WHERE id = ?\", (slug, post_id))\n    except sqlite3.IntegrityError:\n        raise SlugTaken(f\"Another Post already uses '{slug}'.\") from None\n=== app/publish.py\n\"\"\"Render the public site into site/ as plain HTML.\n\nTwo rules the rubric checks:\n\n  1. Only PUBLISHED content is written here. A draft that reaches site/ is a bug.\n  2. Every href and src is RELATIVE (\"style.css\", \"posts/x.html\"), never\n     root-absolute (\"/style.css\"), because Pages serves this from a subfolder.\n     Pages one folder down (posts/) reach the site root with a `root` of \"../\".\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport shutil\nimport sqlite3\nfrom contextlib import closing\nfrom datetime import datetime\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom jinja2 import Environment, FileSystemLoader, select_autoescape\n\nfrom app import settings\nfrom app.db import connect\nfrom app.rendering import render_body\n\n# The wording comes from notes/client-brief.md. Make no other claim about ASA.\nWELCOME = (\n    \"ASA is a Kenyon student group primarily for African students and students \"\n    \"with African backgrounds, while welcoming anyone interested in African \"\n    \"cultures and community.\"\n)\nHOME_ANNOUNCEMENTS = 5\n\nCSS = \"\"\"/* Minimal starter styles — make them yours. */\n:root { color-scheme: light dark; }\nbody { font: 16px/1.6 system-ui, sans-serif; margin: 0 auto; max-width: 42rem; padding: 1rem; }\nheader { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.5rem 1.5rem; align-items: baseline; }\nheader a { font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; }\na:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid currentColor; outline-offset: 2px; }\nmain { margin-block: 2rem; }\nimg { max-width: 100%; height: auto; }\n.card { border: 1px solid; border-radius: 0.5rem; padding: 0.75rem 1rem; margin-block: 1rem; }\n.card-title { margin: 0; font-size: 1.2rem; }\n.meta { margin: 0.25rem 0 0; font-size: 0.9rem; opacity: 0.8; }\n\"\"\"\n\n\ndef environment() -> Environment:\n    return Environment(\n        loader=FileSystemLoader(str(settings.TEMPLATES)),\n        autoescape=select_autoescape([\"html\"]),\n    )\n\n\ndef _day(timestamp: str) -> tuple[str, str]:\n    \"\"\"A stored UTC timestamp as (\"2026-09-28\", \"28 September 2026\").\"\"\"\n    moment = datetime.fromisoformat(timestamp)\n    return moment.date().isoformat(), f\"{moment.day} {moment:%B %Y}\"\n\n\ndef _published_posts(database: Path) -> list[dict]:\n    \"\"\"Published Posts only, newest First-published date first.\n\n    Ordered by First-published date, not by edit time, so a correction never\n    moves a Post. The byline is the Author's Display name; the Username is not\n    even selected.\n    \"\"\"\n    with closing(connect(database)) as conn:\n        rows = conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT posts.title, posts.slug, posts.body, posts.updated_at, \"\n            \"posts.first_published_at, users.display_name AS author_name \"\n            \"FROM posts JOIN users ON users.id = posts.author_id \"\n            \"WHERE posts.status = 'published' \"\n            \"ORDER BY posts.first_published_at DESC, posts.id DESC\"\n        ).fetchall()\n    return [_post_for_template(row) for row in rows]\n\n\ndef _post_for_template(row: sqlite3.Row) -> dict:\n    posted_iso, posted_label = _day(row[\"first_published_at\"])\n    post = {\n        \"title\": row[\"title\"], \"slug\": row[\"slug\"], \"author_name\": row[\"author_name\"],\n        \"body_html\": render_body(row[\"body\"]),\n        \"posted_iso\": posted_iso, \"posted_label\": posted_label,\n        \"updated_iso\": None, \"updated_label\": None,\n    }\n    if row[\"updated_at\"] > row[\"first_published_at\"]:\n        post[\"updated_iso\"], post[\"updated_label\"] = _day(row[\"updated_at\"])\n    return post\n\n\ndef render_site(out: Path | None = None, database: Path | None = None) -> Path:\n    out = out or settings.SITE\n    database = database or settings.DATABASE_PATH\n    if out.exists():\n        shutil.rmtree(out)\n    (out / \"posts\").mkdir(parents=True)\n    env = environment()\n    published = _published_posts(database)\n    common = {\"site_title\": settings.SITE_TITLE}\n\n    def write(name: str, template: str, **context) -> None:\n        (out / name).write_text(env.get_template(template).render(\n            **common, **context))\n\n    (out / \"style.css\").write_text(CSS)\n    write(\"index.html\", \"public/home.html\", title=settings.SITE_TITLE, root=\"\",\n          welcome=WELCOME, posts=published[:HOME_ANNOUNCEMENTS])\n    write(\"announcements.html\", \"public/announcements.html\",\n          title=f\"Announcements · {settings.SITE_TITLE}\", root=\"\", posts=published)\n    for post in published:\n        write(f\"posts/{post['slug']}.html\", \"public/post.html\", root=\"../\", post=post,\n              title=post[\"title\"])\n    return out\n=== app/cli.py\n\"\"\"The `cms` command: serve, publish, deploy, create-admin.\n\n    uv run cms create-admin --username NAME --display-name \"ASA Leadership\"\n                          # password is read from CMS_ADMIN_PASSWORD, never typed or printed\n    uv run cms serve      # admin console + public preview at http://localhost:8000\n    uv run cms publish    # render site/ from published content\n    uv run cms deploy     # push site/ to the gh-pages branch (Pages serves it)\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport argparse\nimport os\nimport subprocess\nimport sys\n\nfrom app import accounts, settings\nfrom app.publish import render_site\n\n\ndef main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:\n    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog=\"cms\")\n    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest=\"command\", required=True)\n    serve = sub.add_parser(\"serve\", help=\"run the admin console locally\")\n    serve.add_argument(\"--port\", type=int, default=8000)\n    serve.add_argument(\"--reload\", action=\"store_true\", default=True)\n    admin = sub.add_parser(\"create-admin\", help=\"create the first Admin account\")\n    admin.add_argument(\"--username\", required=True)\n    admin.add_argument(\"--display-name\", required=True,\n                       help=\"the public byline, e.g. 'ASA Leadership'\")\n    sub.add_parser(\"publish\", help=\"render site/ from published content\")\n    deploy = sub.add_parser(\"deploy\", help=\"push site/ to gh-pages\")\n    deploy.add_argument(\"--message\", default=\"Publish site\")\n    args = parser.parse_args(argv)\n\n    if args.command == \"serve\":\n        import uvicorn\n\n        uvicorn.run(\"app.main:app\", port=args.port, reload=args.reload)\n        return 0\n\n    if args.command == \"create-admin\":\n        password = os.environ.get(\"CMS_ADMIN_PASSWORD\")\n        if not password:\n            print(\"Set CMS_ADMIN_PASSWORD in the environment (see .env.example).\")\n            return 1\n        try:\n            accounts.create_account(\n                settings.DATABASE_PATH, username=args.username, password=password,\n                role=\"admin\", display_name=args.display_name)\n        except accounts.AccountError as error:\n            print(error)\n            return 1\n        print(f\"Created Admin account '{args.username}'.\")\n        return 0\n\n    if args.command == \"publish\":\n        out = render_site()\n        print(f\"Wrote {out}. Preview it with:  python3 -m http.server -d {out} 8001\")\n        return 0\n\n    if args.command == \"deploy\":\n        if not settings.SITE.exists():\n            print(\"site/ does not exist yet — run `uv run cms publish` first.\")\n            return 1\n        result = subprocess.run(\n            [sys.executable, \"-m\", \"ghp_import\", \"-n\", \"-p\", \"-m\", args.message,\n             str(settings.SITE)],\n        )\n        if result.returncode == 0:\n            print(\"Pushed to gh-pages. Settings -> Pages -> Deploy from a branch -> \"\n                  \"gh-pages / root, then wait up to 10 minutes.\")\n        return result.returncode\n    return 1\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    raise SystemExit(main())\n=== tests/conftest.py\n\"\"\"Shared test fixtures.\n\n`client` gives you the app. `client_as(role)` gives you a client that is logged\nin as a seeded user of that role, so access-control tests stay one line:\n\n    def test_editor_cannot_manage_users(client_as):\n        assert client_as(\"editor\").get(\"/admin/users\").status_code in (302, 403)\n\nEvery test gets its own throwaway SQLite database, seeded with the two demo\naccounts below (the same ones scripts/seed_demo.py creates). Accounts sign in\nwith a username, not an email address.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\n\nimport pytest\nfrom fastapi.testclient import TestClient\n\nfrom app import accounts\nfrom app.main import create_app\n\n# Matches scripts/seed_demo.py. Passwords come from the environment there; in\n# tests they are fixed and meaningless.\nDEMO_USERS = {\n    \"admin\": {\"username\": \"admin\", \"password\": \"test-admin-pw\"},\n    \"editor\": {\"username\": \"editor\", \"password\": \"test-editor-pw\"},\n}\n\n_TOKEN = re.compile(r'name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"([^\"]+)\"')\n\n\ndef csrf_token(client: TestClient, path: str = \"/login\") -> str:\n    \"\"\"Read the CSRF token from the form on `path` (what a browser would submit).\"\"\"\n    return token_in(client.get(path).text)\n\n\ndef token_in(html: str) -> str:\n    match = _TOKEN.search(html)\n    assert match, \"no csrf_token field in the page\"\n    return match.group(1)\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef db_path(tmp_path):\n    path = tmp_path / \"test.db\"\n    accounts.seed_demo_accounts(\n        path,\n        admin_password=DEMO_USERS[\"admin\"][\"password\"],\n        editor_password=DEMO_USERS[\"editor\"][\"password\"],\n    )\n    return path\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef client(db_path) -> TestClient:\n    return TestClient(create_app(database=db_path))\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef client_as(db_path):\n    \"\"\"Return a factory: client_as(\"editor\") -> a logged-in TestClient.\"\"\"\n\n    def _login(role: str) -> TestClient:\n        user = DEMO_USERS[role]\n        c = TestClient(create_app(database=db_path))\n        response = c.post(\n            \"/login\",\n            data={\"username\": user[\"username\"], \"password\": user[\"password\"],\n                  \"csrf_token\": csrf_token(c)},\n            follow_redirects=False,\n        )\n        assert response.status_code in (302, 303), (\n            f\"Login as {role} failed with {response.status_code}\")\n        return c\n\n    return with roles and Permission refusal.\n\nSeam 1 (the admin console over HTTP): everything here is what a signed-in\nperson sees and can do, or what the server answers to a request sent directly.\n\"\"\"\nimport re\nimport time\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom tests.conftest import csrf_token, token_in\n\nREFUSAL = \"you don't have permission\"\n\n\ndef create_post(client, title=\"Afrobeat Night\", body=\"What: music\", **kw):\n    response = client.post(\n        \"/admin/posts\",\n        data={\"title\": title, \"body\": body,\n              \"csrf_token\": csrf_token(client, \"/admin/posts/new\")},\n        follow_redirects=False, **kw,\n    )\n    assert response.status_code == 303, response.text\n    return int(re.search(r\"/admin/posts/(\\d+)/edit\", response.headers[\"location\"]).group(1))\n\n\ndef post_to(client, path, **data):\n    data[\"csrf_token\"] = csrf_token(client, \"/admin/posts/new\")\n    return client.post(path, data=data, follow_redirects=False)\n\n\ndef edit_page(client, post_id):\n    response = client.get(f\"/admin/posts/{post_id}/edit\")\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n    return response.text\n\n\ndef time_of(html, name):\n    \"\"\"The machine-readable time in <time id=\"name\" datetime=\"...\">, or None.\"\"\"\n    match = re.search(rf'<time id=\"{name}\"[^>]*datetime=\"([^\"]*)\"', html)\n    return match.group(1) if match else None\n\n\ndef slug_of(html):\n    match = re.search(r'id=\"post-slug\"[^>]*>([^<]+)<', html)\n    assert match, \"the slug is not shown\"\n    return match.group(1).strip()\n\n\ndef is_refusal(response):\n    return response.status_code == 403 and REFUSAL in response.text.lower()\n\n\n# -- writing, drafts, editing ----------------------------------------------\n\ndef test_editor_creates_a_draft_and_it_is_listed(client_as):\n    editor = client_as(\"editor\")\n    post_id = create_post(editor, \"Afrobeat Night\", \"What: music\\n\\nWhere: Gund\")\n    html = edit_page(editor, post_id)\n    assert \"Afrobeat Night\" in html\n    assert \"What: music\" in html\n    assert \"draft\" in html.lower()\n    assert \"Afrobeat Night\" in editor.get(\"/admin/posts\").text\n\n\ndef test_author_is_the_signed_in_account_and_needs_no_form_field(client_as):\n    editor = client_as(\"editor\")\n    assert 'name=\"author' not in editor.get(\"/admin/posts/new\").text\n    html = edit_page(editor, create_post(editor))\n    assert \"ASA Events Team\" in html      # the editor's Display name\n    assert \"ASA Leadership\" not in html\n\n\ndef test_posts_record_created_and_updated_times_automatically(client_as):\n    editor = client_as(\"editor\")\n    html = edit_page(editor, create_post(editor))\n    assert time_of(html, \"created\")\n    assert time_of(html, \"updated\")\n\n\ndef test_editing_saves_the_new_title_and_body(client_as):\n    editor = client_as(\"editor\")\n    post_id = create_post(editor, \"Old title\", \"old body\")\n    before = time_of(edit_page(editor, post_id), \"updated\")\n    time.sleep(0.01)\n    response = post_to(editor, f\"/admin/posts/{post_id}\", title=\"New title\", body=\"new body\")\n    assert response.status_code == 303\n    html = edit_page(editor, post_id)\n    assert \"New title\" in html and \"new body\" in html\n    assert \"Old title\" not in html\n    assert time_of(html, \"updated\") > before\n\n\ndef test_a_post_needs_a_title(client_as):\n    editor = client_as(\"editor\")\n    response = post_to(editor, \"/admin/posts\", response = post_to(editor, f\"/admin/posts/{post_id}\", title=\"Corrected\", body=\"fixed time\")\n    assert response.status_code == 303\n    assert \"fixed time\" in edit_page(editor, post_id)\n    # ...and the Author is still the person who wrote it.\n    assert \"ASA Leadership\" in edit_page(editor, post_id)\n\n\ndef test_editing_a_missing_post_is_not_found(client_as):\n    assert post_id).lower()\n\n    assert post_to(editor, f\"/admin/posts/{post_id}/publish\").status_code == 303\n    published = edit_page(editor, post_id)\n    assert 'id=\"post-status\"' in published\n    assert re.search(r'id=\"post-status\"[^>]*>\\s*Published', published)\n\n    assert post_to(editor, f\"/admin/posts/{post_id}/unpublish\").status_code == 303\n    assert  assert control in admin_html\n        assert control not in editor_html\n\n\nADMIN_ONLY = [\n    (\"post\", \"/admin/posts/{id}/delete\", {}),\n    (\"post\", \"/admin/posts/{id}/slug\", {\"slug\": Nothing here looks at internal functions.\n\"\"\"\nimport logging\nimport re\nimport sqlite3\n\nimport pytest\nfrom fastapi.testclient import TestClient\n\nfrom app.main import create_app\nfrom app.publish import render_site\nfrom tests.conftest import DEMO_USERS, csrf_token, token_in\nfrom tests.test_t02_posts import create_post, is_refusal, post_to\n\nNEW_PASSWORD = \"brand-new-secret-1\"\nRESET_PASSWORD = \"reset-secret-xyz-2\"\n\n\ndef create_account(admin, *, username=\"newbie\", password=\"newbie-pass-1\",\n                   role=\"editor\", display_name=\"New Member\"):\n    response = post_to(admin, \"/admin/users\", username=username, password=password,\n                       role=role, display_name=display_name)\n    assert response.status_code == 303, response.text\n    return int(re.search(r\"/admin/users/(\\d+)\", response.headers[\"location\"]).group(1))\n\n\ndef account_page(admin, user_id):\n    response = admin.get(f\"/admin/users/{user_id}\")\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n    return response.text\n\n\ndef shown(html, name):\n    \"\"\"The text of <... id=\"account-NAME\">...</...> on an account page.\"\"\"\n    match = re.search(rf'id=\"account-{name}\"[^>]*>\\s*([^<]+?)\\s*<', html)\n    assert match, f\"account-{name} is not shown\"\n    return match.group(1)\n\n\ndef user_id_of(db_path, username):\n    with sqlite3.connect(db_path) as conn:\n        return conn.execute(\"SELECT id FROM users WHERE username = ?\",\n                            (username,)).fetchone()[0]\n\n\ndef sign_in(db_path, username, password):\n    \"\"\"A fresh client signing in; returns (client, sign-in response).\"\"\"\n    client = TestClient(create_app(database=db_path))\n    response = client.post(\n        \"/login\", data={\"username\": username, \"password\": password,\n                        \"csrf_token\": csrf_token(client)}, follow_redirects=False)\n    return client, response\n\n\ndef can_sign_in(db_path, username, password):\n    return sign_in(db_path, username, password)[1].status_code in (302, 303)\n\n\ndef author_post(db_path, username, title=\"Afrobeat Night\"):\n    \"\"\"A Published Post written by `username`, made through the app.\"\"\"\n    client, _ = sign_in(db_path, username, \"newbie-pass-1\")\n    post_id = create_post(client, title, \"What: music\")\n    assert post_to(client, f\"/admin/posts/{post_id}/publish\").status_code == 303\n    return post_id\n\n\n# -- creating accounts -------------------------------------------------------\n\ndef test_admin_creates_an_account_that_can_sign_in(client_as, db_path):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    user_id = create_account(admin, username=\"amara\", password=\"amara-pass-99\",\n                             role=\"editor\", display_name=\"Amara O.\")\n    html = account_page(admin, user_id)\n    assert shown(html, \"role\") == \"Editor\"\n    assert shown(html, \"display-name\") == \"Amara O.\"\n    assert shown(html, \"status\") == \"Active\"\n    assert \"Amara O.\" in admin.get(\"/admin/users\").text\n    assert can_sign_in(db_path, \"amara\", \"amara-pass-99\")\n\n\ndef test_admin_can_create_another_admin(client_as, db_path):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    create_account(admin, username=\"second\", password=\"second-pass-1\", role=\"admin\",\n                   display_name=\"Second Leader\")\n    client, _ = sign_in(db_path, \"second\", account page.\"\"\"\n    match = re.search(rf'id=\"account-{name}\"[^>]*>\\s*([^<]+?)\\s*<', html)\n    assert match, f\"account-{name} is not shown\"\n    return match.group(1)\n\n\ndef \"newbie-pass-1\")\n    post_id = create_post(client, title, \"What: music\")\n    assert post_to(client, f\"/admin/posts/{post_id}/publish\").status_code == 303\n    return post_id\n\n\n# -- creating It holds only the\\naccount id and a CSRF token. The account is looked up on every request, so a\\nDeactivated account stops working immediately.\\n\\\"\\\"\\\"\\nfrom __future__ import annotations\\n\\nimport secrets\\nimport sqlite3\\n\\nfrom fastapi import HTTPException, Request\\nfrom starlette.responses import RedirectResponse\\nfrom starlette.types import ASGIApp, Receive, Scope, Send\\n\\nfrom app import accounts\\n\\nSAFE_METHODS = {\\\"GET\\\", \\\"HEAD\\\", \\\"OPTIONS\\\"}\\n\\n\\ndef current_user(request: Request) -> sqlite3.Row | None:\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"The signed-in, active account for this request, or None.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    user_id = request.session.get(\\\"user_id\\\")\\n    if user_id is None:\\n        return None\\n    user = accounts.get_user(request.app.state.database, user_id)\\n    if user is None or not user[\\\"active\\\"]:\\n        request.session.clear()\\n        return None\\n    return user\\n\\n\\ndef sign_in(request: Request, user: sqlite3.Row) -> None:\\n    # A fresh session (and CSRF token) on sign-in, so nothing from before it lives on.\\n    request.session.clear()\\n    request.session[\\\"user_id\\\"] = user[\\\"id\\\"]\\n\\n\\ndef sign_out(request: Request) -> None:\\n    request.session.clear()\\n\\n\\ndef csrf_token(request: Request) -> str:\\n    token = request.session.get(\\\"csrf\\\")\\n    if not token:\\n        token = request.session[\\\"csrf\\\"] = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)\\n    return token\\n\\n\\nasync def verify_csrf(request: Request) -> None:\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Reject any state-changing request that lacks this session's token.\\n\\n    Registered on the whole app, so a new route cannot forget it.\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    if request.method in SAFE_METHODS:\\n        return\\n    expected = request.session.get(\\\"csrf\\\")\\n    form = await request.form()\\n    supplied = form.get(\\\"csrf_token\\\") or \\\"\\\"\\n    if not expected or not secrets.compare_digest(str(supplied), expected):\\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail=\\\"Invalid or missing CSRF token.\\\")\\n\\n\\nclass AdminGuard:\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Send anyone who is not signed in away from every /admin address.\\n\\n    A middleware rather than a per-route check, so it also covers addresses\\n    that do not exist (they must not answer differently to a signed-out visitor).\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n\\n    def __init__(self, app: ASGIApp) -> None:\\n        self.app = app\\n\\n    async def __call__(self, scope: Scope, receive: Receive, send: Send) -> None:\\n        if scope[\\\"type\\\"] == \\\"http\\\" and (\\n                scope[\\\"path\\\"] == \\\"/admin\\\" or scope[\\\"path\\\"].startswith(\\\"/admin/\\\")):\\n            request = Request(scope, receive)\\n            user = current_user(request)\\n            if user is None:\\n                await RedirectResponse(\\\"/login\\\", status_code=303)(scope, receive, send)\\n                return\\n            scope.setdefault(\\\"state\\\", {})[\\\"user\\\"] = user\\n        await self.app(scope, receive, send)\\n\\\"\\\"\\\"Template rendering for the admin console.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\nfrom __future__ import annotations\\n\\nfrom fastapi import Request\\nfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\\n\\nfrom app import security, settings\\n\\ntemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))\\n\\n\\ndef render(request: Request, name: str, status_code: int = 200, **context):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Render an admin template with the CSRF token every form needs.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    context.setdefault(\\\"title\\\", \\\"Admin\\\")\\n    context[\\\"csrf_token\\\"] = security.csrf_token(request)\\n    context[\\\"home_path\\\"] = \\\"/admin\\\"\\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(request, name, context, status_code=status_code)\\n\\\"\\\"\\\"The FastAPI application.\\n\\nThe admin console lives under /admin (signed-in only), with /login and /logout\\nbeside it; the public site preview answers at /.\\n\\nAdd your routes in their own modules (app/routes/posts.py and so on) and include\\nthem here. Keep this file small.\\n\\\"\\\"\\\"\\nfrom __future__ import annotations\\n\\nfrom pathlib import Path\\n\\nfrom fastapi import Depends, FastAPI, Request\\nfrom starlette.middleware.sessions import SessionMiddleware\\n\\nfrom app import security, settings\\nfrom app.routes import admin, auth\\nfrom app.web import templates\\n\\nSESSION_LIFETIME_SECONDS = 8 * 60 * 60\\n\\n\\ndef create_app(database: Path | None = None) -> FastAPI:\\n    # Every state-changing request is CSRF-checked, whatever route it reaches.\\n    app = FastAPI(title=\\\"IPHS 400 MP2 CMS\\\",\\n                  dependencies=[Depends(security.verify_csrf)])\\n    app.state.database = database or settings.DATABASE_PATH\\n\\n    app.include_router(auth.router)\\n    app.include_router(admin.router)\\n\\n    @app.get(\\\"/\\\")\\n    def public_home(request: Request):\\n        return templates.TemplateResponse(\\n            request, \\\"public/home.html\\\",\\n            {\\\"title\\\": settings.SITE_TITLE, \\\"items\\\": []},\\n        )\\n\\n    # Middleware added last is outermost: the session must be loaded before the\\n    # guard runs, and saved after it.\\n    app.add_middleware(security.AdminGuard)\\n    app.add_middleware(\\n        SessionMiddleware, secret_key=settings.SECRET_KEY, session_cookie=\\\"cms_session\\\",\\n        max_age=SESSION_LIFETIME_SECONDS, same_site=\\\"lax\\\",\\n    )\\n    return app\\n\\n\\napp = create_app()\\n\\\"\\\"\\\"Accounts: creating them, hashing passwords, checking sign-in.\\n\\nA password is never stored, returned or logged in plain form; only the argon2\\nhash is kept. The username is private (sign-in only); the Display name is the\\npublic byline. Accounts are deactivated, never deleted.\\n\\\"\\\"\\\"\\nfrom __future__ import annotations\\n\\nimport sqlite3\\nfrom contextlib import closing\\nfrom pathlib import Path\\n\\nfrom argon2 import PasswordHasher\\nfrom argon2.exceptions import InvalidHashError, VerificationError\\n\\nfrom app.db import connect\\n\\nROLES = (\\\"admin\\\", \\\"editor\\\")\\nMIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH = 8\\n\\n_hasher = and a Deactivated account all return\n    None, so the caller can give one generic message for all three.\n    \"\"\"\n    with closing(connect(path)) as conn:\n        user = conn.execute(\n with closing(connect(path)) as conn, conn:\n        conn.execute(\"UPDATE users SET active = ? WHERE username = ?\",\n                     (int(active), username))\n\n\nclass NoSuchAccount(AccountError):\n    pass\n\n\nclass WouldLockOutAdmins(AccountError):\n    \"\"\"The change would leave the console with no active Admin, or lock out the caller.\"\"\"\n\n\ndef list_accounts(path: Path) -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n    with closing(connect(path)) as conn:\n        return conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT * FROM users ORDER BY active DESC, display_name COLLATE NOCASE, id\"\n        ).fetchall()\n\n\ndef _found(conn: sqlite3.Connection, user_id: int) -> sqlite3.Row:\n    user = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ?\", (user_id,)).fetchone()\n    if user is None:\n        raise NoSuchAccount(\"No such account.\")\n    return user\n\n\ndef _other_active_admins(conn: sqlite3.Connection, user_id: int) -> int:\n    return conn.execute(\n        \"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE role = 'admin' AND active = 1 AND id != ?\",\n        (user_id,)).fetchone()[0]\n\n\ndef change_role(path: Path, user_id: int, role: str) -> None:\n    if role not in ROLES:\n        raise AccountError(f\"Role must be one of: {', '.join(ROLES)}.\")\n    with closing(connect(path)) as conn, conn:\n        user = _found(conn, user_id)\n        if (role != \"admin\" and user[\"role\"] == \"admin\" and user[\"active\"]\n                and not _other_active_admins(conn, user_id)):\n            raise WouldLockOutAdmins(\n                \"This is the last active Admin. The username is private (sign-in only); the Display name is the\npublic byline. Accounts are deactivated, never deleted.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\nfrom contextlib import closing\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom argon2 import PasswordHasher\nfrom argon2.exceptions import InvalidHashError, VerificationError\n\nfrom app.db import connect\n\nROLES = (\"admin\", \"editor\")\nMIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH = 8\n\n_hasher = PasswordHasher()\n# Checked when the username is unknown, so a miss takes as long as a wrong\n# password and timing does not reveal which usernames exist.\n_DUMMY_HASH = _hasher.hash(\"not-a-real-password\")\n\n\nclass AccountError(ValueError):\n    \"\"\"A request to create an account that cannot be honoured.\"\"\"\n\n\nclass UsernameTaken(AccountError):\n    pass\n\n\ndef hash_password(password: str) -> str:\n    return _hasher.hash(password)\n\n\ndef _password_matches(stored_hash: str, password: str) -> bool:\n    try:\n        return _hasher.verify(stored_hash, password)\n    except (VerificationError, InvalidHashError):\n        return False\n\n\ndef create_account(path: Path, *, username: str, password: str, role: str,\n                   display_name: str) -> int:\n    username, display_name = username.strip(), display_name.strip()\n    if not username or not display_name:\n        raise AccountError(\"A username and a Display name are required.\")\n    if role not in ROLES:\n        raise AccountError(f\"Role must be one of: {', '.join(ROLES)}.\")\n    _check_password(password)\n    try:\n        with closing(connect(path)) as conn, conn:\n            cursor = conn.execute(\n                \"INSERT INTO users (username, password_hash, role, display_name) \"\n                \"VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n                (username, hash_password(password), role, display_name),\n            )\n            return cursor.lastrowid\n    except sqlite3.IntegrityError:\n        raise UsernameTaken(f\"An account named '{username}' already exists.\") from None\n\n\ndef authenticate(path: Path, username: str, password: str) -> sqlite3.Row | None:\n    \"\"\"Return the account for a correct username and password, else None.\n\n    An unknown username, a wrong password and a Deactivated account all return\n    None, so the caller can give one generic message for all three.\n    \"\"\"\n    with closing(connect(path)) as conn:\n        user = conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT * FROM users WHERE username = ?\", (username.strip(),)\n        ).fetchone()\n    matches = _password_matches(user[\"password_hash\"] if user else _DUMMY_HASH,\n                                password)\n    if user is None or not matches or not user[\"active\"]:\n        return None\n    return user\n\n\ndef get_user(path: Path, user_id: int) -> sqlite3.Row | None:\n    with closing(connect(path)) as conn:\n        return conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ?\", (user_id,)).fetchone()\n\n\ndef set_active(path: Path, username: str, active: bool) -> None:\n    with closing(connect(path)) as conn, conn:\n        conn.execute(\"UPDATE users SET active = ? WHERE username = ?\",\n                     (int(active), username))\n\n\nclass NoSuchAccount(AccountError):\n    pass\n\n\nclass WouldLockOutAdmins(AccountError):\n    \"\"\"The change would leave the console with no active Admin, or lock out the caller.\"\"\"\n\n\ndef list_accounts(path: Path) -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n    with closing(connect(path)) as conn:\n        return conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT * FROM users ORDER BY active DESC, display_name COLLATE NOCASE, id\"\n        ).fetchall()\n\n\ndef _found(conn: sqlite3.Connection, user_id: int) -> sqlite3.Row:\n    user = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ?\", (user_id,)).fetchone()\n    if user is None:\n        raise NoSuchAccount(\"No such account.\")\n    return user\n\n\ndef _other_active_admins(conn: sqlite3.Connection, user_id: int) -> int:\n    return conn.execute(\n        \"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE role = 'admin' AND active = 1 AND id != ?\",\n        (user_id,)).fetchone()[0]\n\n\ndef change_role(path: Path, user_id: int, role: str) -> None:\n    if role not in ROLES:\n        raise AccountError(f\"Role must be one of: {', '.join(ROLES)}.\")\n    with closing(connect(path)) as conn, conn:\n        user = _found(conn, user_id)\n        if (role != \"admin\" and user[\"role\"] == \"admin\" and user[\"active\"]\n                and not _other_active_admins(conn, user_id)):\n            raise WouldLockOutAdmins(\n                \"This is the last active Admin. Make another account an Admin first.\")\n        conn.execute(\"UPDATE users SET role = ? WHERE id = ?\", (role, user_id))\n\n\ndef deactivate(path: Path, user_id: int, *, acting_user_id: int) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Deactivate an account (never delete it). An Admin cannot deactivate themself.\"\"\"\n    with closing(connect(path)) as conn, conn:\n        _found(conn, user_id)\n        if user_id == acting_user_id:\n            raise WouldLockOutAdmins(\"You cannot deactivate your own account.\")\n        conn.execute(\"UPDATE users SET active = 0 WHERE id = ?\", (user_id,))\n\n\ndef reactivate(path: Path, user_id: int) -> None:\n    with closing(connect(path)) as conn, conn:\n        _found(conn, user_id)\n        conn.execute(\"UPDATE users SET active = 1 WHERE id = ?\", (user_id,))\n\n\ndef change_display_name(path: Path, user_id: int, display_name: str) -> None:\n    display_name = display_name.strip()\n    if not display_name:\n        raise AccountError(\"A Display name is required.\")\n    with closing(connect(path)) as conn, conn:\n        _found(conn, user_id)\n        conn.execute(\"UPDATE users SET display_name = ? WHERE id = ?\",\n                     (display_name, user_id))\n\n\ndef reset_password(path: Path, user_id: int, password: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Replace an account's password hash. The old password is never readable.\"\"\"\n    _check_password(password)\n    with closing(connect(path)) as conn, conn:\n        _found(conn, user_id)\n        conn.execute(\"UPDATE users SET password_hash = ? WHERE id = ?\",\n                     (hash_password(password), user_id))\n\n\ndef seed_demo_accounts(path: Path, *, admin_password: str,\n                       editor_password: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Create the demo Admin and Editor if they do not exist yet.\"\"\"\n    demo = [\n        (\"admin\", admin_password, \"admin\", \"ASA Leadership\"),\n        (\"editor\", editor_password, \"editor\", \"ASA Events Team\"),\n    ]\n    for username, password, role, display_name in demo:\n        try:\n            create_account(path, username=username, password=password, role=role,\n                           display_name=display_name)\n        except UsernameTaken:\n            pass\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":43,"oldLines":6,"newStart":43,"newLines":12,"lines":["         return False"," "," ","+def _check_password(password: str) -> None:","+    if len(password) < MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH:","+        raise AccountError(","+            f\"The password must be at least {MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH} characters.\")","+","+"," def create_account(path: Path, *, username: str, password: str, role: str,","                    display_name: str) -> int:","     username, display_name = username.strip(), display_name.strip()"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false,"contentNotInModelContext":true},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"29830b01-df1a-47cb-87f5-0af866d606f6","session_id":"ed24a1e3-881f-4be6-a801-a77028a939ce","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/yawoppong-krampah/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"ed24a1e3-881f-4be6-a801-a77028a939ce","version":"2.1.288","gitBranch":"main"}

Templates ask\n`can(role, action)` only to hide controls; hiding is never the protection.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import Request\n\nADMIN = \"admin\"\nEDITOR = \"editor\"\nEVERYONE = frozenset({ADMIN, EDITOR})\nADMIN_ONLY = frozenset({ADMIN})\n\nRULES: dict[str, frozenset[str]] = {\n    \"post.list\": EVERYONE,\n    \"post.create\": EVERYONE,\n    \"post.edit\": EVERYONE,\n    \"post.publish\": EVERYONE,\n    \"post.unpublish\": EVERYONE,\n    \"post.delete\": ADMIN_ONLY,\n    \"post.change_slug\": ADMIN_ONLY,\n}\n\n\nclass PermissionRefused(Exception):\n    \"\"\"The signed-in account's role may not do this action.\"\"\"\n\n\ndef allowed(role: str, action: str) -> bool:\n    # An action missing from the table is refused, never allowed by accident.\n    return role in RULES.get(action, frozenset())\n\n\ndef require(action: str):\n    \"\"\"A route dependency: refuse the request unless the role may `action`.\n\n    Runs before the route looks anything up, so an Editor gets the same\n    refusal whether or not the thing they asked about exists.\n    \"\"\"\n    if action not in RULES:\n        raise KeyError(f\"unknown action: {action}\")\n\n    def check(request: Request) -> None:\n        if not allowed(request.state.user[\"role\"], action):\n            raise PermissionRefused(action)\n\n    return check\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":20,"oldLines":6,"newStart":20,"newLines":14,"lines":["     \"post.unpublish\": EVERYONE,","     \"post.delete\": ADMIN_ONLY,","     \"post.change_slug\": ADMIN_ONLY,","+    \"user.list\": ADMIN_ONLY,","+    \"user.view\": ADMIN_ONLY,","+    \"user.create\": ADMIN_ONLY,","+    \"user.change_role\": ADMIN_ONLY,","+    \"user.deactivate\": ADMIN_ONLY,","+    \"user.reactivate\": ADMIN_ONLY,","+    \"user.reset_password\": ADMIN_ONLY,","+    \"user.change_display_name\": ADMIN_ONLY,"," }"," "," "]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false,"contentNotInModelContext":true},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"87ef5d6a-c4ce-4622-8f5f-982b697a9243","session_id":"ed24a1e3-881f-4be6-a801-a77028a939ce","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/yawoppong-krampah/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"ed24a1e3-881f-4be6-a801-a77028a939ce","version":"2.1.288","gitBranch":"main"}
